coverage.name: Kiowa County
limitations: Excluded: Kiowa County Ballot Issue 1A (Resolution 2026-8), a 1.5% countywide sales and use tax "FOR GENERAL COUNTY PURPOSES (50%) AND COUNTY ROADS AND BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION AND MAINTENANCE PURPOSES (50%)", for 15 years; no housing earmark.
Excluded: Kiowa County Ballot Issue 1B (Resolution 2026-9), a waiver of the 5.25% property tax limit with retention of all revenues; general revenue retention with no housing earmark.
Excluded: County School District RE-1 Issue 4A (school debt); not housing.
County Resolutions 2026-08, 2026-09 and 2026-10 were posted on September 28 as image-only scans and could not be read; 2026-10 is not reflected in any ballot question.

The county Notice of Election and Sample Ballots folder (linked from the clerk page, files dated September 28) holds a notice of election and five precinct sample ballots (001-1, 001-2, 002-2, 003-2, 004-2), all read on 2026-10-03. No separate TABOR notice or participating-entities list was posted.
